notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
We've just updated the game to version 1.03 which fixes the issue with the game getting stuck sometimes when calculating the containment roll.

Also we've been be listening to your feedback and in the next update we're aiming to make it possible to skip the animation on the containment roll and also the mutation check.

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
We've just updated the game with several bug fixes:
[list][*]Fixed: Achievement screen layout.
[*]Fixed: Clear achievement button removed as it has no effect on Steam edition of the game.
[*]Fixed: Quick Game exit button sometimes didn't show.
[*]Fixed: Issue with Quick Game scrolling and layout.
[*]Fixed: Reference to swipe on loading screen replaced with click.
[*]Added: Description for custom game.[/list]
Please report any other issues via the forum and we'll take a look into them!

~ The HexWar Games Team
